details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 1 - The Apprentices · Seat 3, Healer

A stout, unhurried dwarf priestess of Ilmater who patches up everyone, enemies included if they'll hold still. Calm as a cellar; apologises to every wound she stitches and hums funeral hymns at entirely the wrong moments. Ilmater teaches that nobody should suffer alone, and the Keepers go wherever people get hurt.

In a fight

Stay behind the Fighter, open with Bless, keep people standing with Cure Light Wounds, and use Sacred Flame when nobody needs patching.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Spell Use. Divine caster, Wisdom-based, save DC 14. Cantrips at will. 2 1st-level slots a day (1 + 1 for Wis 18), refreshed by a long rest. Each morning prepare 4 1st-level spells (level 1 + Wis +3) from the whole Cleric list. Your holy symbol covers common components. Casting uses your action; damage taken while casting forces a Fortitude save (DC 10 or half the damage) or the spell is lost.

Turn Undead. Action, 6 times a day (3 + Wis). Present your holy symbol: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you makes a Will save (DC 14) or flees and cannot come within 30ft of you for 1 minute.

Ilmater's Mercy (granted power). Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks. Once a day: heal one creature for 2d8+3 HP.

Weapon Selection. Club, crowbill hammer, dagger, light/heavy flail, light hammer, light/heavy mace, morningstar, staff, war hammer, plus Ilmater's cestus, all without Disadvantage. Dwarf training adds handaxe, battleaxe, light crossbow and firearms.

Dwarf. Medium size, speed 25ft (not reduced by armour or encumbrance), darkvision 60ft.

Stoneworker. Advantage on checks about stonework, underground construction and unusual stonework.

Poison-hardy. Advantage on saves against poison; Resistance 5 to poison damage.

Craft: Brewing. Advantage on Brewing checks (free dwarf craft skill, not an NWP slot).

The Clan Weapon. Her heavy mace is her clan's weapon. If she loses it, she has Disadvantage on Charisma checks with other dwarves until she gets it back.

Stonebraced. Once per long rest, treat an incoming critical hit as a normal hit, or ignore a knockdown.

Weapon and armour training. Handaxe, battleaxe, warhammer, light crossbow, firearms; light and medium armour.

Healer (Arcane & Devout, Cleric 1st-level feat). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die (Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+2). Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot (a free Cure Light Wounds).

Notes. Speed: 25ft (never reduced by armour or load) · Initiative: +1 · HP: d8 max (8) + Con mod (+2) = 10. Untrained NWPs are rolled with Disadvantage; everyday checks (notice, climb, intimidate) are plain attribute checks.

Casting

Every spell is resolved by the target's save against your DC. Tick a slot box when you cast; slots return after a full rest. Cantrips are cast at will. Tick the circle beside a spell to mark it prepared.

Sacred Flame (cantrip): 60ft, one creature you can see: 1d4 radiant, Reflex negates; cover gives no bonus to the save. At will.

Toll the Dead (cantrip): 60ft, one creature: 1d4 necrotic, or 1d6 if it is below its maximum HP; Will negates. At will.

First Aid (cantrip): Touch: a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP, no roll. It stays unconscious until healed or for 1 hour. Restores no HP.

Cure Light Wounds (1st, prepared): Touch, one creature: heals 1d8+1, +1 for Healer = 1d8+2 HP, no save. Reversed (Cause Light Wounds): 1d8+1 necrotic, Fortitude halves. One free cast a day from Healer.

Bless (1st, prepared): 50ft, up to 6 allies, 1 minute: Advantage on their first attack roll each round and +1 to saving throws. No save.

Sanctuary (1st, prepared): Touch, one creature, 1 round: anyone trying to attack it or target it with a harmful spell must first pass a Will save or choose another target. Ends if the protected creature attacks or casts an offensive spell.

Command (1st, prepared): 30ft, one creature that understands your language: on its next turn it obeys one word, Approach, Drop, Flee or Halt. Will negates. Mindless creatures are immune; harmful commands are ignored.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 4 (Cuir Bouille, Medium) + 1 (Dex, Medium max +2) + 1 (Medium Wooden Shield) = 16

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol — every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you rolls a Will save.
  • Turn DC = 10 + half your Cleric level (rounded down, minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier
  • Below 8th level: failed save = turned — undead flees and cannot approach within 30ft for 1 minute
  • 8th level and above: failed save = destroyed outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level, otherwise turned
  • Evil Clerics may turn OR control undead under the same DC — controlling requires your Cleric level to be 5 or more above the undead's Level. Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and you can control at most your Cleric level in total Levels of undead at once

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
  • The choice is permanent.
  • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level).
  • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
  • A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.

7th Level

  • Extra Attack (Battle Priest only): When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Holy Campaign

  • Effect: Raise 1–100 NPCs with d8 HD plus 1–100 NPCs with d4 HD. All gain +1 on checks while the Cleric is present.
  • Scales at 19th: 2–200 / 2–200 NPCs, bonus increases to +2
  • Scales at 23rd: 4–400 / 4–400 NPCs, bonus increases to +3, gains 1st/2nd/3rd level leaders per 20 troops

20th Level

  • Perfect Recall: recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot; from 24th level it also works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

21st Level

Banish

  • Effect: Turn-undead-equivalent ability used against extraplanar creatures.
  • Banishes for 21+ days
  • Affects 1d12 minor demons or devils
  • Affects 1d6 major demons or devils
  • Affects 1 demon lord or arch devil

22nd Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: Permanent 20ft aura that radiates divine power. Cannot be dispelled.
  • All creatures within the aura are immune to death attacks
  • +3 to the Turn Undead DC
  • +2 to all attribute checks and saves within the aura

23rd Level

Mark of the Saint

  • Effect: Recognised as a saint regardless of alignment.
  • Gains 1d10 followers per Wisdom point
  • Grants weekly: Heal, Remove Blindness or Deafness, Remove Disease
  • Grants daily: Holy or Unholy Word
  • Grants weekly: Resurrection

Deities — Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power.
  • The archdevils and demon lords not listed here (every one but Asmodeus and Lolth) serve only as Warlock patrons.
